next.reason: 1985: after the USE procedure, if the I-O status 'does not indicate a critical input-output error' control returns to the next executable statement after the I-O statement; otherwise 'the implementor determines what action is taken'. 2023: §2023:14.9.49.4 GR7 b) 'control is returned to an implicit CONTINUE statement following the input-output statement whose execution caused the exception', c) for a fatal EC-I-O condition 'the implementor determines what action is taken'; §2023:9.1.14 'then control is transferred to the end of the input-output statement'; §2023:A.1 item 218 'USE statement (action taken following execution of the USE procedure when I-O status value indicates a fatal exception condition)' keeps it implementor-defined. The MERGE/SORT case only defers to those statements. Same effect.
